# Old Bellwether

## Overview

Claims to have surveyed the marsh route for [[The Ambergris Company]] forty years ago.

## On the Way Out (Session 4)

Said he had been paid never to mention the survey, then mentioned it, unprompted, twice.

## Notes

Either a witness or a plant. The crew has no way to tell yet and should not act as
though it does.
